rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for assessing a result, situation, or performance.

example.english: The management completed an evaluation of the situation after the typhoon.
example.traditional: 管理層完成咗對颱風過後情況嘅評估。
example.jyutping: gun2 lei5 cang4 jyun4 sing4 zo2 deoi3 toi4 fung1 gwo3 hau6 cing4 fong3 ge3 ping4 gu2

rows.note: Use this specifically for an assessment of someone's work, academic performance, or suitability, often linked to promotion or rewards.

example.english: The company will decide on raises based on the annual evaluation results.
example.traditional: 公司會按年度考核結果決定加唔加人工。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 wui5 on3 nin4 dou6 haau2 hat6 git3 gwo2 kyut3 ding6 gaa1 m4 gaa1 jan4 gung1

rows.note: Use this mainly for a formal personnel or workplace performance review rather than a general assessment.

example.english: The personnel department will conduct the annual evaluation of all employees next month.
example.traditional: 人事部將於下月進行全體員工嘅年度評核。
example.jyutping: jan4 si6 bou6 zoeng1 jyu1 haa6 jyut6 zeon3 hang4 cyun4 tai2 jyun4 gung1 ge3 nin4 dou6 ping4 hat6
